title: C3 — drop record (one line of runs/<id>/stage2/dropped.jsonl)
description: C3 rule 6: a candidate present in stage1/candidates.jsonl and absent from stage2/candidates.jsonl must have a stage-2 line explaining the proof. This is that line. Added 2026-10-22 (W5) as a clarification of rule 6, which already required it without naming the file. A drop with no proof is a silent recall loss; `irqrace runstore check` fails the run.

reason.description: 'priority' = B's flow can never run while the local flow is active (E1, E2, E3, E5). 'masking' = it could on priority, but its interrupt is masked at every point of every path of the interval (or at the access, for a pair), after every mask change a flow able to run there could make (F1-F9). 'no-path' = no control-flow path leads from A1 to A2 within one activation (H1c), which stage 1's cross-function may-precede over-approximated.

proof.description: The argument, in prose, with the source lines it rests on.

relies_on.description: Identifiers in wiki/Soundness Assumptions.md. Revisiting an assumption means grepping for it here.
